text.p: Universal International Inc said Friday it would seek to raise additional equity financing to recapitalize the company and fund expansion of its retail store base.
The company said it expected to it would have to sell a significant equity interest in Universal and to raise the new equity from either industry participants or financial investors.

"The liquidation of the wholesale business has now been substantially completed, however, we will continue to see some residual costs during the last half of the year to complete the process," Mark Ravich, chief executive, said in a statement. "With our full focus now on being a retailer, we anticipate that sales will continue to improve throughout the remainder of the year."
